saints.name: St. Raymond Nonnatus
saints.title: Mercedarian Priest
saints.shortBlurb: A Mercedarian friar who spent himself ransoming Christian captives from slavery, even offering his own body as pledge…
biography: Raymond was born in Catalonia about 1204 and joined the young Order of Our Lady of Ransom, the Mercedarians, founded to redeem Christians held captive by the Moors. He gave himself wholly to this work, traveling to North Africa to buy back the enslaved.

When his money was spent, tradition tells that he offered himself as a hostage to free others, and that his captors pierced and padlocked his lips to stop him preaching Christ. Ransomed at last and named a cardinal shortly before his death, he died in 1240 and is invoked as patron of expectant mothers, midwives, and the falsely accused.
saints.knownFor: Ransoming captives and offering himself in their place.
